dogecoin.text: Before announcing Tesla would no longer be accepting Bitcoin due to its negative impact on the environment, Musk asked Twitter if Tesla should start accepting Dogecoin. Over 77% responded "Yes." #Doge4Tesla https://t.co/MmpCXqJ10Y
